abstract: Covers DNS Queries over HTTPS (DoH). RFC 8484 DNS Queries over HTTPS (DoH) is current; RFC 9460 Service Binding and Parameter Specification via the DNS (SVCB and HTTPS Resource Records) is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
